notes: DiscoFlate v3.88.0 — 🧹 The command editor lines up. It mixed label-above fields with inline checkboxes in the same flex row, so nothing shared a baseline, and the react emoji sat in an unlabelled box floating beside a tickbox. It now uses the same layout language as the Scenes properties panel — labelled fields, checkboxes at a matching height, and grouped sections: identity, where it runs, the notify overlay, and what it starts. The emoji field only appears once you've actually turned the reaction on, and the notify line and its explanation only appear when the overlay is enabled.
